title: ALMA 200 pc Resolution Imaging of Smooth Cold Dusty Disks in Typical z ∼ 3 Star-forming Galaxies
question: Do typical main-sequence z~3 star-forming galaxies show star-forming dust clumps/substructures at 200-pc resolution, and how do they compare with SMGs?

data.angular_resolution: nominal 31 mas; final beam 42 x 30 mas

what.value: ALMA 1.3 mm HUDF survey source catalog/fluxes (sample selection)

evidence.quote: The three galaxies in this sample were selected from the ALMA HUDF Survey at 1.3 mm (cite: Dunlop17).
a new, deblended far-IR photometric catalog described by (cite: Elbaz18) is used in this work
We have corrected all *HST* images for the astrometric offsets reported by (cite: Rujopakarn16)
utilizing the most recent revision of the (cite: Barro11) photometric compilation

what.value: H19 SMG stellar masses (MAGPHYS) and redshifts

evidence.quote: those from H19 based on the energy-balancing `MAGPHYS` tabulated

recipe.method: ALMA pipeline calibration then tclean with Briggs robust 0.5, Hogbom, cell 6 mas
Fit point, circular and elliptical Gaussians to visibilities simultaneously for all components, until residuals show no peaks >=3 sigma
key_parameters: all parameters free; fluxes corrected with tclean primary beam

recipe.method: uv fits of check source and phase/flux calibrators
Stellar mass from HYPERZ and PPG08 averaged; GALFIT of H160; L_IR, M_dust from Draine&Li SED fit; SFR via Kennicutt
assumptions: solar metallicity, GDR(Zsun) ~ 90; Chabrier IMF; Calzetti law, A_V up to 5

recipe.goal: Limits on substructure SFR and SFR surface density maps
recipe.method: Scale local 870 um residual noise per beam to total flux and total SED SFR; build Sigma_SFR from noise-free Gaussian models
assumptions: dust temperature and IMF do not vary within each source

recipe.method: Same GILDAS uv-plane procedure applied to archival 2016.1.00048.S pipeline products; identify substructures by subtracting dominant components
assumptions: SFR linear with rest 150-350 um dust emission (constant T_dust and IMF)

evidence.quote: integrated fluxes of 1.56 $\pm$ 0.16 mJy and 1.84 $\pm$ 0.16 mJy
with an integrated flux of $2.0 \pm 0.1$ mJy
yielding a combined flux of $2.80 \pm 0.1$ mJy

answer_key.quantity: Max clump fraction of total SFR (3 sigma)

evidence.quote: no more than $\simeq$ 1, 1, and 7% respectively (3$\sigma$ upper limits

answer_key.quantity: Astrometric offset of check source (RA, Dec)

evidence.quote: the typical fractional SFRs in substructures in the H19 SMGs range from 4 to 10%, with two substructures being as large as $30-36$%

not_stated_but_needed: Exact tclean niter, threshold, image size and masking used for the final image
Line-free channel handling (none needed, but spectral window flagging not stated)
Multiscale scales used for final image
GILDAS uv_fit starting guesses and model-selection details
SED-fitting photometry values and priors for L_IR, M_dust
GALFIT setup details (PSF, masks, initial guesses)
missing_for_reproduction: SED photometry tables and fitting priors
score_reason: Public data and clear uv-fit procedure, but many imaging and SED fitting details missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, main results numeric (component fluxes/sizes), recipe mostly specified via pipeline plus GILDAS uv_fit.
